# HexPiece 3.6.3

The Mochi fruit's new moveset (the reference GIFs you sent), the 3D Haki lightning, and the HUD hidden while your powers are off.
**Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 13 test suites pass, and every move was rendered in previews and compared with its GIF.

## The Haki lightning is 3D everywhere, with sharp tips
Your words: "make the lightning 3d once it for all, all of it" and "the tip of the lightning has to be sharp".
- Every Haki lightning (the Conqueror's release, the lightning out of every move's explosion, the sparks, clashes, the sword and the
  fighting styles' crackle) is now drawn as round, lit 3D tubes: black with a glossy sheen, your Haki colour wrapping its edges. No flat
  strips anywhere, and the original mod's flat beams are gone completely.
- Every bolt ends in a needle-sharp point.

## No HUD while your powers are off
Your words: "when powers are turned off, the hud on the screen is to dissappear until the power is once again activated."
While your powers are off (R held), the abilities panel, the fruit energy bar and the old "POWERS OFF" badge are hidden. The only thing
left is the small bar that fills while you hold R to turn them back on. Everything comes back the moment your powers are on.

## The Mochi fruit: the reference's moves (the old moves are gone)
Your words: "I WANT THE OTHER MOVES, all of them, I want yours gone". Kept from the old kit: the left-click punches. Removed: Mochi Tsuki
(right click), Sticky Mochi, Future Sight (double-tap Shift) and every other old move.
- **Left click: Mochi Punch.** Your own arm becomes the mochi arm.
- **Z (hold): Grilled Mochi.** Your pointed arm bursts into a huge puff of white dough that settles into a thick arm with a fist at its
  end, dripping. Let go and the fist flies on a jet of fire; whoever it hits is carried along on it until it explodes in rings of fire.
  The longer you hold, the bigger the explosion. The target keeps burning for a few seconds.
- **X: Mochi Muddle.** You dive into a splash of dough that lands as a pool round you, then runs out along the ground ahead with
  splashed, spiky edges. Whoever it reaches or walks in is stuck and hurt, more near its start.
- **C: Lotus Mochi Combo.** A ribbon of dough flies out to your left and balls up into a big donut. Its fist punches the one ahead,
  throws them high into the air, three small donuts punch them up there, and a giant fist rides them down into the ground: a splat of
  dough, rocks thrown, a crater.
- **V: Chestnut Mochi.** A comet of dough flung up curls into a dark spiked disc over your head. For about six seconds it fires spikes
  down white tracer lines at the nearest foe in range, then turns white, falls and splats round your feet.
- **B (hold): Mochi Anemone.** About twenty small donuts pop up over the place you aim at and Haki arms shoot down out of them under a
  white dome. Let go: a last flash, the dome bursts, white splats are left on the ground.
- **N: Buzz Cut Mochi** (5-minute cooldown). You turn into a white donut wheel and roll where you look, tearing up a double row of floor
  tiles behind you. When you hit someone you unroll, your right arm becomes a thin white mochi arm with an enormous spiked Haki ball on
  its end, and the ones you caught (and anyone the ball sweeps past) stick to the ball. You whirl them round you level with the ground
  in a white vortex, stretch the arm up to an insane height, then slam it down far ahead: a fan of red Haki streaks, a black star of a
  crater, a field of rubble. It plays as a cutscene for you and the ones caught (cameras by your side, above the whirl, below the raised
  arm, off to the side for the slam), with **your own impact frame** on the hit and on the slam. The rolling rumble stops the moment the
  wheel stops.
- **M: the Awakening.** Its own moves (the awakened set: the trident, Grilled Lance, Elastic Lasso, Oblivion, Power Mochi, Blazing
  Storm, Scorching Buzz Cut) come in the next version.

With the Conqueror's Haki and Ryou on, the Mochi moves throw the Conqueror's lightning, out of their explosions and slams.
